metadata.description: Mods for Claude Code: a command deck, a GitHub issues pane, a prompt upgrader and automatic model selection.

plugins.name: command-deck
plugins.description: One band above the prompt: session, git, context and plan-limit meters, cost, and your mods, model and effort controls.

plugins.name: github-issues
plugins.description: A /issues pane listing the repo's open GitHub issues; click one to open it, or send it to the prompt.

plugins.name: prompt-upgrade
plugins.description: Turns a rough prompt into a better one before it is sent: a few quick questions, a rewrite, and a side-by-side review.

plugins.name: auto-model
plugins.description: Picks the right model for each prompt you type, quietly, when switched on.
